meta.prompt: Plan two days in Kyoto as an inline itinerary. Day 2 (Arashiyama and the north): 08:30 Bamboo Grove, 10:00 Tenryu-ji garden, 13:00 lunch then Kinkaku-ji, 17:30 Pontocho Alley dinner. Each stop expands for details when tapped.
